text.EN: Please… let me stay. We have been walking for days, and I do not know how much longer the others can keep going.
text.TL: Please... hayaan mo akong manatili. Ilang araw na kaming naglalakad, at hindi ko alam kung gaano katagal kayang magpatuloy ang iba.

text.EN: I am not asking for much. A roof, a meal, and a chance to be useful. Please let us join you.
text.TL: Hindi ako humihingi ng marami. Isang bubong, isang pagkain, at isang pagkakataon na maging kapaki-pakinabang. Mangyaring hayaan mo kaming samahan ka.

text.EN: You have a settlement. We have nothing left but each other. If there is room, I will work for it.
text.TL: You have a pamayanan. We have nothing left but each other. If there is room, I will trabaho for it.

text.EN: Thank you. I thought I would have to keep walking until there was nowhere left to go.
text.TL: salamat po. Naisip ko na kailangan kong magpatuloy sa paglalakad hanggang sa wala na akong mapupuntahan.
